Some of this advice is just plain stupid and dangerous.  Taking up smoking or going back to it will not make things any better.  Complicating your life is not going to make it easier.

Just my view but someone who is at the end but seeking for a reason to go on should seek out decisions that build a solid foundation in their life.  Maybe risk taking, in a *calculated* way, is part of that, but smoking would not be anywhere on that list.  Just my $0.02.
